# Update score-formula test suite to plain reputation count

Parent: CG-0MT3J8FXG006RCOA (Main Street: reputation score multiplier (x5) should become a simple count)

## Goal

Update all test assertions that encode the old reputation **x5** final-score multiplier so they assert the new plain-count formula (`coins + reputation + challenges x challengeBonusPoints`) and the retuned win thresholds (Easy 100 / Medium 120 / Hard 150). This is the test-first prerequisite slice: it defines the expected behaviour that F2 (the atomic engine/AI/UI change) must satisfy.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No test file references `reputationScoreMultiplier` / `REPUTATION_SCORE_MULTIPLIER` or hardcodes `rep * 5` in a score assertion: `tests/main-street/{difficulty-presets,turnflow,integration,ai-strategy,hud-tooltips}.test.ts`, `tests/rule-engine/EconomyLedger.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/MainStreetOverlay.browser.test.ts`.
- [ ] Score assertions use `coins + reputation + challengesCompleted.length * challengeBonusPoints` (axes: no multiplier; challenge multiplier retained).
- [ ] Win-threshold expectations updated to 100 (Easy) / 120 (Medium) / 150 (Hard).
- [ ] Browser overlay test mock `config` no longer includes `reputationScoreMultiplier`; its score-breakdown assertions reflect the plain count.
- [ ] Targeted runs green with F2: `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/ tests/rule-engine/` and `npx vitest run --project browser tests/main-street/MainStreetOverlay.browser.test.ts`.

## Key Files

- tests/main-street/difficulty-presets.test.ts
- tests/main-street/turnflow.test.ts
- tests/main-street/integration.test.ts
- tests/main-street/ai-strategy.test.ts
- tests/main-street/hud-tooltips.test.ts
- tests/main-street/MainStreetOverlay.browser.test.ts
- tests/rule-engine/EconomyLedger.test.ts

## Notes

- Do NOT update income-side reputation multiplier assertions (`applyReputationMultiplier`, `rep-multiplier` effect) — those are out of scope.
- Tests exist that assert the old formula and will fail until F2 lands; the dependency edge F2→F1 encodes this ordering.
data.title: Update score-formula test suite to plain reputation count

data.description:
# Engine, config, AI, UI: drop reputation score multiplier

Parent: CG-0MT3J8FXG006RCOA (Main Street: reputation score multiplier (x5) should become a simple count)

## Goal

Remove the reputation **x5** final-score multiplier entirely (plumbing removed, not neutralised) and retune win thresholds. Final score becomes `coins + reputation + challenges x challengeBonusPoints`. This is the single compile-coupled slice: removing `reputationScoreMultiplier` from `GameConfig` breaks the build at every consumer (engine, AI x3, UI x3) until all are updated in the same commit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `computeScore()` (MainStreetEngine.ts) computes `coins + reputation + challengesCompleted.length * challengeBonusPoints` — no reputation multiplier anywhere in final-score calculation (docstring updated).
- [ ] `reputationScoreMultiplier` field removed from `GameConfig` and from all three presets (EASY/MEDIUM/HARD) in MainStreetDifficulty.ts; `REPUTATION_SCORE_MULTIPLIER` constant removed from MainStreetCards.ts.
- [ ] Win thresholds retuned: Easy 100, Medium 120, Hard 150 (from 120/150/180); engine end-check and AI planning horizon keep using `config.winThreshold` unchanged.
- [ ] AI strategy (MainStreetAiStrategy.ts, 3 scoring sites + doc comments) values reputation at 1 point per unit — multiplier removed — keeping purchase decisions consistent with the new score function.
- [ ] UI breakdowns show no `x5`: game-over overlay (MainStreetOverlayContent.ts), HUD score tooltip (MainStreetHudTooltips.ts), help-panel scoring sentence (MainStreetLifecycleManager.ts) display plain reputation count.
- [ ] Income-side reputation multipliers untouched and behaviour-verified: `applyReputationMultiplier` (1 + rep/20, capped x3) and `rep-multiplier` income effect (Community Renovation x1.2) unchanged — targeted income test run shows identical results.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds and full unit + browser suite green (with F1 test slice).

## Key Files

- example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetDifficulty.ts
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetAiStrategy.ts
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetLifecycleManager.ts

## Notes

- Save/load does not serialise config (verified), so no save-compat concern.
- Challenges are counted, not reputation-scaled; the `challengeBonusPoints` multiplier remains.
- No transcript/replay format change required (transcripts record resources/events, not the score formula).
data.title: Engine, config, AI, UI: drop reputation score multiplier

data.description:
# Monte Carlo sanity-check and full-suite verification

Parent: CG-0MT3J8FXG006RCOA (Main Street: reputation score multiplier (x5) should become a simple count)

## Goal

Verify the reputation multiplier removal end-to-end: re-run the Monte Carlo harness to sanity-check balance impact (score deflation expected — do NOT gate on exact parity), verify income-side multipliers are behaviourally unchanged (scope guard), and confirm the full test suite and build are green.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `npm run monte-carlo` runs clean; win-rate/score distributions recorded in a work-item comment with score deflation documented as expected (no parity gating).
- [ ] Games still reach a decisive endpoint under the retuned 100/120/150 thresholds (win/lose outcomes present, no pathological non-termination flagged by the harness).
- [ ] Income-side reputation multipliers verified unchanged: targeted tests for `applyReputationMultiplier` (1 + rep/20, capped x3) and `rep-multiplier` income effect produce identical results to pre-change expectations.
- [ ] Full `npm test` (unit + browser + tutorial E2E) passes and `npm run build` succeeds at the final commit.

## Key Files

- example-games/main-street/MainStreetMonteCarlo.ts
- tests/main-street/ (all, via full suite)
- docs/main-street/monte-carlo-baseline.json (reference, may be regenerated by harness run)

## Notes

- This is a verification slice, not a code-change slice; it blocks on F2 and F3.
- No gate on score parity — the operator explicitly accepted score deflation.
data.title: Monte Carlo sanity-check and full-suite verification
